camera.description: The configured camera to show. The dropdown lists the gateway's cameras; any name or binding works.

playback.description: What is playing. Both values are written back as the component's controls and the player move them.

mode.description: live, or playback of recordings at time. Live / back-30s / the timeline write this.

time.description: Playback position (epoch ms). Written back about once a second while playing; writing it seeks.

quality.description: auto (the camera's own stream, transcoded only when this browser cannot decode it), or a transcode profile from Camera Settings (e.g. 720p); the dropdown lists the profiles. Applies to live video and playback. Also accepted: main, sub, or custom (the size and bitrate in customQuality).

customQuality.description: Used when quality is custom: the video is transcoded to this height and bitrate.

height.description: Height in pixels, 120-2160; never above the camera's own.

transport.description: Live video transport. auto uses the gateway's default; hls is low-latency HLS through the gateway's own port (about 1-2 s behind); webrtc is about 0.2-0.5 s behind but needs the media port reachable, and falls back to HLS when it is not.

muted.description: Mute audio. Browsers block autoplay with sound, so unmuting needs a user gesture.

fit.description: How the picture fills the component.

status.description: The nameplate over the picture: state dot, camera name, LIVE or the playback time.

controls.description: The control bar under the picture.

show.description: Show the control bar (Live, back 30 s, play, speed, range).

collapsed.description: Control bar and timeline hidden behind a small tab in the picture's bottom-right corner. Written back when the user collapses or restores them.

bookmarks.description: Show the bookmark button. Bookmarks are attributed to the session user.

snapshots.description: Show the snapshot button: a JPEG of the shown moment opens in a new tab.

timeline.description: The recording timeline under the control bar.

range.description: How much time the timeline spans. Written back when the user changes it from the control bar.

ptz.description: Pan, tilt and zoom, for an ONVIF camera with a PTZ service.

show.description: Allow the PTZ pad and its toggle on the control bar, when the camera has PTZ.

visible.description: The pad is showing over the live picture. Written back when the user toggles it.

speed.description: Speed of a held arrow or zoom button, 0.1-1.
